extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially new users trying to create a page)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for creating a new Wikipedia article: account/autoconfirmation requirements, searching for existing pages, handling capitalization and redirects, waiting for propagation, and checking deletion logs. Also points to alternatives like the article wizard and requesting a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly; alternatives include using the article wizard or requesting a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article (alternative paths)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are options if you cannot create the article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer guided creation and review before full publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Bob Dylan Nobel Prize in Literature" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, ensure the topic is not already covered under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examining incoming links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate locations for redirects and help determine whether a standalone article is necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page was just created, wait a few minutes or try the purge function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure correct capitalization and create redirects from common variants so readers can find the article regardless of minor differences in title spelling or case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing the deletion log can explain why a page was removed and what changes (content, sourcing, notability) might be needed before attempting recreation.
